restrictions: The witness is the ordinary collision of the two distinct 128-byte messages in certificates/manifest.json under standard-IV SHA-256 reduced to steps 0 through 30, with FIPS padding and all 256 digest bits.
time_log2 37.0 and preprocessing_log2 37.0 are the same ceiling. The explicit sum in proof.md is 125747909721.06871 target compressions, whose base-2 logarithm is 36.871743, strictly below 2^37.0.

Every search trial is charged at 525 primitive 32-bit operations divided by 2140: 501 on the fast path plus 24 for address arithmetic and abort tests. The charged search is the successful yield run of 353104822376 trials, including sibling-thread work after the collision index.
The z3 term is the hardware ceiling in H-Z3-HARDWARE-CEILING. It is included in the sum. It is not an instruction trace.
Expected time is not used. The yield search final counter includes sibling-thread work after the collision index.
This package claims no full SHA-256 collision and no 32-round collision.

heuristics.statement: All local z3 5.1.0 attempts that produced or failed to produce the starting solution are charged at 1 core * 6e9 cycles/s * 8 32-bit operations/cycle * 1200 seconds / 2140 = 26915887850.46729 target compressions. The process was single-threaded, so the previous 16-core multiplier is not charged.
heuristics.scope: The one-time starting-solution search for the witness in proof.md, including timed-out attempts on the same characteristic.
heuristics.extrapolation: z3 emits no collision-frontier-v5 trace. The bound uses one core for 1200 seconds. The successful bit-blast returned before its 150-second timeout. Eight operations per cycle is above a sustained integer throughput for this CPU. A smaller trace would only lower the claim.
heuristics.limitations: The bound is not a retired-instruction receipt. If a reviewer shows that the charged attempts exceeded 1*6e9*8*1200 primitive 32-bit operations, the ceiling is invalid. Crossing 2^37.0 total units invalidates the score.

heuristics.statement: At most 2^16 records in the yield search enter the section-6 completion loop. Each is charged 2^22 draws at 80 primitives, which is 10275809605.383177 target compressions and is included in the 37.0 sum.
heuristics.scope: The yield search that returned the verified pair.
heuristics.extrapolation: The yield log does not print a completion-entry counter. 2^16 is an explicit cap. If the run entered the loop more often, this premise is false and the score is invalid.
heuristics.limitations: This is not a measured counter. It is a cap. Exceeding it invalidates the ceiling.
